_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Uri gukina Klondike Solitaire. Iradusha kwawe ni kuhimiza karata zote kwa mirongo ya msingi.

Amategeko ya Mchezo:
- Mirongo ya msingi (F1-F4): Tegura ukwira kuva Ace hadi King kwa sauti
- Mirongo ya meza (T1-T7): Tegura ukaguka kwa rangi zinapishana (umutuku kwa umweru, umweru kwa umutuku)
- Stock: Soma karata kwa mirongo ya taka
- Taka (W): Karata ya juu irahari kwa gukina

Komandi:
- 'draw' - Soma karata kuva stock hadi taka
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Hamisha karata hagati ya mirongo
  Urugero: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count kandi inaweza kuwa 'all', ishakora kuhimiza karata zote zigaragara.
- 'forfeit' - Oza mchezo wawe utarikiye na ufunge alama yawe
- Amazina ya mirongo: W (taka), F1-F4 (mirongo ya msingi), T1-T7 (mirongo ya meza)

Ushobora kuteza ibikorwa byinshi muri tour moja ukabitandukanya na vigatiti:
  Urugero: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Ni Abami gusa wabasha kuwekwa kuri mirongo ya meza itari.
Ibikorwa bitegurwa kwa mpanganyo - ico kimwe kitakayabura, ibikorwa bisigaye bitakayitabiriwa.
Tangira 'forfeit' ukiyumvisha mchezo utakayeza kugera kuwina.

format_error.no_brackets: Imiterere y'ibikorwa idakwiriye. Ibikorwa bigomba kuba mu nkingi.

format_error.count_invalid: Kubara si sahihi. Tumia nambari cyangwa 'all'
